disposition_reason: Table 2 prints element concentrations for seven canned tuna, salmon and sardine products from Taif markets, though only as ppm in the digest filtrate.

study.design: market survey of seven canned fish brands (triplicate cans) for microplastics and elements
study.origin: manufacturer countries Indonesia, Italy, Thailand, Morocco as labelled
study.method: 10% KOH digestion of about 40 g can contents (fish plus brine or oil) at 40 °C for 72 h, filtration, ICP-MS of filtrate for 20 elements
study.qa: no CRM, recovery or LOD reported

material.label_as_printed: Canned tuna (whole can contents with brine or oil)

findings.group: canned tuna, manufacturer country Indonesia, Taif market (Tuna Indonesia)
findings.integrity_flag: Table 2 reports concentration in the KOH-digest filtrate in ppm, not in fish tissue; the text nonetheless compares these values with tissue limits in µg/g. Not expressible per kg of fish.
findings.notes: Mean ± SD 5.0092 ± 0.001 ppm in filtrate; value_ugkg null because the unit is per filtrate, not per kg fish. Triplicate cans of one brand, pooled.
